name: Softmax Depth Gradient Derivation
definition: A method to compute gradients for a softmax-scaling depth formulation used in the rasterizer, assuming Gaussians Gi along a camera ray are ordered from closest (alpha1) to farthest (alphaN).
summary: Softmax Depth Gradient Derivation computes gradients for depth rendering by biasing accumulation toward high-weight Gaussians while allowing gradient propagation to all contributing Gaussians, unlike mode-selection which restricts gradients to the single highest-weight Gaussian.
